segmentName: Pump & Municipal Cast Iron/Ductile Iron Components

market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: India Foundry and Casting Market: $22.0B (2025) to $57.9B by 2034 (10.78%/yr) per IMARC; alternative estimate: India Foundry Market $28.72B (2026) to $46.72B by 2031 (10.22%/yr) per Market.us. Pump-and-valve castings are a specialized sub-segment demanding corrosion-resistant alloys and pressure-rated designs, with water infrastructure, oil & gas, and chemical-processing industries driving volumes.
exportGeographies: 12+ countries (named example: Siddharth Foundry exports to USA, Germany, Sweden, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, Mexico, Argentina, Korea, South Africa, Saudi Arabia)
market.domesticSlice: India's global casting export share is historically ~2-3%; the Ministry of Heavy Industries is targeting a doubling to 6-7%.

structureFacts: Downstream demand driver: industrial pump demand from water infrastructure, oil & gas, and process/chemical industries
Government 'Make in India' and infrastructure push are cited as tailwinds for the broader foundry sector

Reported (unverified, single-source) supply-chain shift: OEMs reportedly moved tonnage of housing-casting business from China to Indian foundries — treat with caution, no independently corroborating source found

adoptionStructure.note: Metallurgical/quality consistency (corrosion resistance, pressure rating), on-time delivery to pump-OEM production lines, in-house machining/sub-assembly capability (finished components vs. raw castings), and export-compliance certification (ISO 9001, third-party works audits) drive vendor qualification with pump OEMs.

steps: offer cast iron and ductile (SG) iron pump castings
offer machined sub-assemblies for submersible, centrifugal, and vertical turbine pumps and pump motors
offer lost-foam castings for complex geometries
run green sand casting process with metallurgical/melting control
operate a plant sized in MT/year with a defined component weight range
operate combined group capacity across sister foundries
maintain vendor-qualification and quality-audit relationships with major pump OEMs
win quality awards from OEM customers at vendor meets
fulfil direct supply contracts with pump OEMs domestically and internationally
manage export logistics to multiple countries
